issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement contains a contradiction for this method's return type. The textual task description (problem_statement.md) states getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() should return a String in the format "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)". However, the UML in the same problem_statement.md lists +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) implements and returns a String. The template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) contains a TODO for this method but no signature. This mismatch (UML says void while text and solution expect String) can mislead students about the correct return type and cause them to implement the wrong signature, leading to failing tests or confusion about expected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent by updating the UML in problem_statement.md to match the textual description and the solution. Replace the UML entry +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void with +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String. Also ensure the template's TODO is implemented with the same signature (public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents()) so students and tests have a single unambiguous expected return type.
